links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of general-purpose multimodal LLMs on fundus photographs across 8 conditions
links.effect: ChatGPT accuracy 75% (603/800), far exceeding Claude (18%), Grok (18%), and Gemini (14%); most general-purpose models performed poorly on this clinical task.
links.quote: ChatGPT achieved the highest diagnostic accuracy (75%; 603/800), far exceeding Claude (18%), Grok (18%), and Gemini (14%).

links.outcome: Comparison of four candidate multimodal LLMs on the same fundus images
links.effect: Accuracy varied widely between models on the same data: ChatGPT 75% vs Claude 18%, Grok 18%, Gemini 14%; agreement across models was low (kappa 0.11-0.16 with ChatGPT).
links.quote: Agreement across models was consistent low (κ = 0.11-0.16 with ChatGPT; κ ≈ 0.05 among Claude, Gemini, and Grok).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the diagnostic accuracy, confidence calibration, and reasoning of four commercial multimodal LLMs on a retrospective dataset of 800 retinal fundus images without testing a deployment practice.
